alsoKnownAs: ጾመ ልደት · Tsome Lidet (the Christmas fast)
abstainFrom: Meat, dairy, eggs and fats. Traditionally one meal a day, after about 3 p.m., with breakfast allowed on Saturdays and Sundays.

verse.text: ነፍሴን በጾም አደከምኃት። I humbled my soul with fasting.

whatItIs: The fast before Genna, Ethiopian Christmas. It runs from Hidar 15 to the eve of Genna, and it is one of the church's seven fasts.
whyItMatters: The prophets kept this fast as they foresaw and longed for the birth of Christ and His work of salvation. It is a time of spiritual renewal, repentance and blessing.
whatPeopleDo: Keep 44 days: 40 for the prophets, 3 for Abraham the Syrian, and 1 for Gehad, the eve of Genna
Celebrate the Sundays before Genna as minor feasts of the Lord: Sibket, Birhan and Nolawi
Give themselves to fasting and prayer until Genna on January 7

sources.title: Teaching on Tsome Nebiyat by Memhir Senay (shared in the parish community, Hidar 2019)
The Ethiopian Orthodox Church (Aymero W. and Joachim M., 1970): fasting rules and minor feasts

review.notes: Content from Memhir Senay's teaching and the church's published calendar. English wording by Dawit: confirm the translation. Open questions: which part is shorter in 43-day years (after a leap year), and which Sundays are Sibket, Birhan and Nolawi.
